SELECT rb.id AS id, rb.subject AS subject, rb.content AS content, rb.created_at AS created_at, rb.hit AS hit, rb.image_url AS image_url, rb.rcp_seq AS rcp_seq,
u1.id AS writer_id, u1.nickname AS writer_nickname, u1.profile_image_url AS writer_profile_image,
rec.rcp_nm AS rcp_nm, rec.att_file_no_main AS att_file_no_main,
u2.id AS chef_id, u2.nickname AS chef_nickname, u2.profile_image_url AS chef_profile_image
FROM review_board rb LEFT OUTER JOIN users u1 ON rb.users_id = u1.id LEFT OUTER JOIN recipe rec ON rb.rcp_seq = rec.rcp_seq LEFT OUTER JOIN users u2 ON rec.user_id = u2.id ORDER BY rb.id DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 12 ROWS ONLY
SELECT id, user_id, subject, content, created_at, hit, image_url, image_size, rcp_seq FROM review_board
